articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 24): Brent crude dips below $90 after hitting 3-month low. What’s happening?
articles.description: Crude oil price : Oil prices have declined as Brent crude hovered around $89 per barrel and WTI around $80. Diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran aim to resolve the ongoing West Asia conflict, creating market uncertainty. Recent Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure have raised concerns regarding regional oil supply security. Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan analysts predict potential price fluctuations based on geopolitical risks and supply disruptions.

articles.title: Japanese bond yields fall as lower oil prices ease inflation concerns
articles.description: Japanese government bond yields declined due to falling oil prices that eased inflation concerns. The 10-year JGB yield reached a two-week low of 2.715%. Meanwhile, Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 index experienced a brief surge of 5% following Nvidia's leadership announcement. Shorter-dated US Treasury yields increased as market stability was reassured by the news. Additionally, markets anticipate a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
